text:
harper: hi team! first-day question excited to be here. running into a couple onboarding snags: Okta SSO fails with 'Device not trusted', Drive shortcut missing (can't find 'Welcome Pack'), and 1Password invite bounced back as 'no seats'. who should I ping?

it-support: hey @harper welcome! for the device trust error, did you enroll your laptop via the company enrollment link and finish the 'Approve' step on the MDM profile?
harper: i followed the link and enrolled, but the browser showed 'enrollment pending' and then redirected. when I retry SSO I get "Device not trusted - no MDM association".
dan: can you run `sudo profiles show` and paste the MDM identifier line (you can redact UUIDs)?
harper: pasted snippet: ```EncryptedProfile: false
MDM: true
MDMServerURL: https://mdm.redwood.ai/enroll
MDMUserApproved: 0```
it-support: MDMUserApproved: 0 explains it  the device is enrolled but the user has not approved the profile locally. Try System Preferences -> Profiles -> select the Redwood MDM profile -> Approve. After that, reboot and attempt Okta again.
harper: clicked Approve, rebooted, Okta still rejects with same message.
it-support: odd. i see an existing device record in the MDM console but it's tied to a different email (harper.personal@). People Ops sometimes provision a temp alias during hire. @people-ops can you check the onboarding mapping for Harper?
people-ops: confirming now  your account was created with a provisioning alias while your legal name was being verified. switched the MDM binding to harper@redwood.ai and reissued the profile.
infra-bot: Ticket #ONB-5129 opened for device-rebind; assignee=it-support; priority=high. ETA 60m.
harper: thanks. small win: i found the 'Welcome Pack' in Shared with me and added a shortcut. Drive access sorted.
it-support: 1Password seats are allocated after Okta account finalization. once the MDM binding is corrected and Okta flows through we can push you into the correct group for 1Password.
harper: ok got an updated MDM profile email, re-enrolled, and Okta now accepts device trust! quick question: 1Password invite still says 'pending'  is there anything i should trigger?
people-ops: we pushed provisioning to the SaaS sync. you should get a 1Password invite within 10 minutes. if not, DM me and i'll manually add you.
harper: invite arrived and accepted. all green now. thanks for the quick turnaround everyone :tada:
dan: welcome aboard @harper! ping #eng-hello for intros and i'll set up the pairing schedule later today.
harper: thanks all  appreciate the help.
